settings.heading: Electric Toothbrush vs Manual Toothbrush?
settings.row_content:
Electric toothbrush bristles vibrate or rotate to help you remove plaque buildup from your teeth and gums. The vibration allows for more micro-movements every time you move your toothbrush across your teeth.

This is the main difference between electric and manual toothbrushes. Manual toothbrushes rely on your ability to effectively brush away plaque and food; electric toothbrushes do the work for you, which has statistically been proven to result in cleaner and whiter teeth.

settings.heading: How do I deep clean the Electric Toothbrush
settings.row_content:
1) Remove the brush head.

2) Rinse the bottom of the brush head with warm water.

3) Rinse the metal shaft area with warm water.

4) Clean the bottom of the toothbrush handle with a damp cotton swab to remove any residue.

5) Wipe the entire surface of the handle with a wet cloth.

settings.heading: Instructions for your Teeth Whitening Powder
settings.row_content:
Wondering how you can get the most out of your PAP+ Teeth Whitening Powder?

There's two ways to using the Teeth Whitening Powder:

1) Start by applying your toothpaste, and then gently dip your toothbrush with the toothpaste into the PAP+ Powder.

2) Alternatively, you can use it as a prelude to your daily brushing routine. Simply dip your toothbrush into the powder, brush your teeth vigorously for 2 minutes, and then proceed with your regular brushing regimen.

Recommended usage time: 3x per week

settings.heading: How to use the electric dental cleaning kit?
settings.row_content:
1. Select your desired attachment based on your oral needs.

2. Turn on the device and alter between modes based on your cleaning needs.

3. Alter between heads if necessary.

4. Clean the device and the tip after use.

settings.heading: Cons of not using an Ultra Sonic Tooth Cleaner
settings.row_content:
Bad dental hygiene can be devastating on teeth and gums. Not only can it be expensive, but it can also lead to bad breath, gum disease, receding gums, dental decay, and even tooth loss.

settings.heading: Cautions
settings.row_content:
Please note this product is suitable for children over 6 years of age and under the age of 60.

If you have or had oral or gum surgery in the last 2 months please do not use this product unless approved by your dentist.

If your gums bleed heavily after using the Electric Toothbrush, please discontinue use and consult your dentist.

This product is strictly designed for oral care (cleaning teeth, gums and tongue) please do not use for other purposes. If you feel any discomfort or pain, please consult your dentist.
